text:
incident-bot: PAGING ALERT — elevated SSE disconnects observed across us-west-1 streaming gateways. service=streaming-proxy. Paging on-call.

alex: I'm on it. seeing a spike in disconnects starting ~20:42 UTC. clients are reconnecting in a storm.

sana: can you paste the proxy error logs? I want to check for parse errors or malformed frames.

logs-bot: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T20:42:11Z] WARN proxy: client disconnect id=abc123 err=upstream reset code=1011
[2026-03-15T20:42:11Z] ERROR toolcall: parse_failed client=mobile-1 payload_len=0
```

maria: confirmed 1011 + parse_failed entries. quick hypothesis: malformed tool-call frames cause the parser to block the connection and the proxy resets upstream -> client sees SSE disconnects.

alex: mitigation options: 1) timebox streaming to non-fncall paths for affected customers, 2) flip a fallback feature flag to treat empty args as null, 3) add temporary rate-limiter on toolcall parsing attempts.

ryan: customer-impact note — two enterprise customers reported partial streaming disconnects in dashboards and one support ticket hit p1. CS already notified.

sana: quick question: are these clients using HTTP/1 SSE or websocket? telemetry shows mix; a lot of mobile clients are on SSE with keepalive=30s.

maria: immediate mitigations I'm proposing: increase SSE keepalive to 90s, enable parser tolerance for empty payloads, and roll a proxy rule to drop blatantly invalid fncall frames. rolling these to canary first.

deploy-bot: config change submitted: streaming-proxy.keepalive=90 (canary 10%).

alex: short command to add proxy rule (infra API):
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api/egress/rules -d '{"rule":"drop_invalid_fncall"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>'
```
I'll run this to canary after approvals.

sana: rolling drop_invalid_fncall rule to canary now.

oncall-bot: handoff reminder: @alex -> @maria in 30m. react :white_check_mark: if accepted.

maria: current timeline (summary): 20:41 first error logged, 20:42 disconnect spike, 20:45 canary config applied (keepalive + drop rule), 20:53 disconnect rate reduced ~70% in canary.

ryan: agreed action items: 1) export full timeline + logs, 2) capture representative client payloads, 3) draft customer comms + mitigation note, 4) schedule follow-up RCA.

alex: logs export link: https://logs.redwood/streams/1943219000 (contains proxy + toolcall traces).

sana: collecting client payload samples now, attaching the most common offending payload.

storage: @maria tagging storage for pcap export of gateway traffic in time window 20:35-20:55. We'll queue the job.

storage: got it, pcap job submitted; estimated availability EOD.

alex: preference is to avoid full rollback if mitigations keep errors low. tracking here.

sana: found repeated offending pattern: clients send a 'tool_call' event with an empty `arguments` string which trips the parser. sample below:
```
{"type":"tool_call","name":"search","arguments":""}
```

maria: that matches parse_failed. parser is currently strict and expects JSON object for `arguments`. plan: patch parser to treat empty string as null and tolerate empty args. hotfix scheduled in ~2h; will push to canary then prod if stable.

oncall-bot: paging status? If impact is reduced, consider switching to monitor-only in 15m.

alex: switching to monitor-only. leaving thread open for RCA artifacts and timeline building. thanks all for quick responses.
